packageRules.description: Boot pins the jOOQ runtime; the codegen plugin and meta-extensions must match it (build.gradle). Dep names: a Gradle plugin's package name is <id>:<id>.gradle.plugin, which matchPackageNames misses.
Native toolchain: exercised by the native job.
The conformance suite's images: one PR, majors included; the PR runs the conformance workflow (paths filter).
prBodyNotes: 这些镜像只有 conformance workflow 会用到；本 PR 会自动跑 conformance，合并前确认它通过。

packageRules.description: Stay on the MongoDB major the suite's own docker-compose uses. mongo 9.0.4 also refuses to start on kernels 6.19-7.0.13 (SERVER-121912), which the former iam-build runner (pve1) was on.
The browser images in scripts/conformance and scripts/native-smoke must match @playwright/test; after the conformance rule so it wins.
react-i18next pins i18next as a peer (18 needs >= 27.0.1); updated apart, the react-i18next PR cannot resolve its lockfile. One PR, majors included.

customManagers.description: Container images pinned at line ends in scripts/ (image=repo:tag, or before a line continuation).
The Playwright image: v-prefixed tag with an OS suffix and a trailing comment, which the rule above skips.
